display.purpose: Large numerical readouts — weather temperature, hero numbers. Weight 200 reads as engraved, not printed.

headline.purpose: Modal titles. The system's largest heading — quiet confidence, never announcement.

title.purpose: Side panel headings, task section headers. Only weight that reads as heading at small scale.

body.purpose: Notes, modal copy, feature lists. Line-height 1.9 is intentional — it breathes. Max 65ch in reading contexts.

label.purpose: Widget card headers (FOCUS, WEATHER), sidebar labels. All-caps + tracking at 10px creates quiet hierarchy without size increase.

mono.purpose: Clock, Pomodoro countdown, pricing, keyboard hints. Space Mono only for numbers and precision readouts.

shadows.name: widget-ambient
shadows.purpose: Default widget card shadow. Inset top highlight simulates glass edge. Always present.

shadows.name: widget-hover
shadows.purpose: Hover state only. Adds faint Indigo glow — proximity signal, not elevation.

shadows.name: accent-glow
shadows.purpose: Logo mark, primary CTA, sidebar brand mark. Identity signal.

shadows.name: teal-pulse
shadows.purpose: Custom cursor dot, playing indicator. Live-state signal only.

motion.name: ease-standard
motion.purpose: Default easing for state transitions (color, background, border).

motion.name: mesh-pulse
motion.purpose: Ambient mesh background animation — scale + rotate. Reduced-motion: disabled.

motion.name: blink-colon
motion.purpose: Clock colon blink — 50% opacity at midpoint.

breakpoints.name: mobile
breakpoints.notes: Sidebar hidden; bottom nav collapses labels; modals go full-width.

breakpoints.name: tablet
breakpoints.notes: Single-column layout; side panel becomes static; widget grid collapses to 1 col.

breakpoints.name: desktop
breakpoints.notes: Full sidebar + widget grid + optional side panel at 360px.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The primary CTA. Gradient Indigo→Teal with an accent glow. Used for submit actions, upgrade prompts, and primary modal actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 34px; padding: 0 16px; border: none; border-radius: 10px; background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(108,99,255,0.95), rgba(0,212,170,0.8)); color: #eeeeff; font-family: 'Outfit', sans-serif; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 400; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: 0 10px 30px rgba(108,99,255,0.25); transition: transform 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1), box-shadow 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { transform: translateY(-1px); box-shadow: 0 14px 32px rgba(108,99,255,0.35); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(0); }

components.name: Ghost Icon Button
components.description: Icon-only action button. Used in widget card headers, top navigation, and inline actions.
components.html: <button class="ds-btn-ghost" aria-label="Refresh"><svg width="14" height="14" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><polyline points="23 4 23 10 17 10"/><path d="M20.49 15a9 9 0 1 1-2.12-9.36L23 10"/></svg></button>

components.name: Widget Card
components.description: The primary repeating container. Glassmorphic, gently rounded, with hover lift.

components.css: .ds-widget-card { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.028); backdrop-filter: blur(24px); -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(24px); border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.055); border-radius: 18px; overflow: hidden; box-shadow: 0 4px 24px rgba(0,0,0,0.3), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.05); transition: all 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); } .ds-widget-card:hover { border-color: rgba(108,99,255,0.2); transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 8px 32px rgba(0,0,0,0.4), 0 0 20px rgba(108,99,255,0.06), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.07); } .ds-widget-header { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; padding: 14px 18px 0; } .ds-widget-label { font-family: 'Outfit', sans-serif; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.12em; color: #7777aa; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-widget-body { padding: 12px 18px 18px; font-family: 'Outfit', sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 300; line-height: 1.9; color: #eeeeff; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Standard text input. Semi-transparent background, Indigo focus border.
components.css: .ds-input { height: 34px; width: 100%; padding: 0 14px; border-radius: 10px; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.04); border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.055); color: #eeeeff; font-family: 'Outfit', sans-serif; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 300; transition: border-color 0.2s, background 0.2s; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: rgba(238,238,255,0.35); } .ds-input:focus { outline: none; border-color: rgba(108,99,255,0.35); background: rgba(255,255,255,0.057); } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: none; }

components.name: Filter Chip – Active
components.description: Selected filter or mode pill. Indigo-tinted fill.

components.name: Sidebar Navigation Item
components.description: Fixed icon sidebar. 52px wide. Items are 36px tall icon buttons with hover and active states.

narrative.overview:
Zenflow is a professional's late-night workspace — dark, polished, everything exactly where it belongs. The interface should feel like premium gear in a quiet room: intentional, unhurried, and completely in service of the work happening inside it.

The atmosphere is the product. Background themes, ambient sounds, and the breathing mesh animation are not decoration — they are first-class UI. Every design decision defers to the ambient experience.

This system explicitly rejects gamified productivity: no achievement toasts, no streak counters, no XP bars, no confetti. Zenflow earns loyalty through experience, not reward loops.
keyCharacteristics: Near-void backgrounds (#08080f) with barely-there glass surfaces
Two named accents: Deep Indigo (primary) + Arctic Teal (active/live states)
Warm Amber reserved exclusively for upgrade/premium signals
Outfit (light weight) + Space Mono pairing — calm prose + precise numbers
Flat by default; depth from border glow, transparency, and blur — not shadow height
Motion is ambient, not celebratory: mesh pulse, colon blink, weather animation — never a pop-in or confetti

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Deep Indigo and Arctic Teal never compete on the same element. Indigo owns identity and selection; Teal owns live state.

rules.name: The Amber Cordon
rules.body: Warm Amber is reserved for upgrade and premium signals. It must not appear in interactive states, focus rings, hover effects, or any element that a free-tier user sees as a normal action prompt.

rules.name: The Featherweight Rule
rules.body: Default to Outfit weight 300. Use 400 only for titles and interactive control labels. Use 600 only for sidebar logo and pricing strong values.

rules.name: The Mono Boundary
rules.body: Space Mono is for numbers and code-adjacent labels only: clock, timer, keyboard shortcut hints, pricing, monospace input fields. Never in prose, navigation items, or widget body copy.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest. The ambient shadow on widget cards is structural (glass edge simulation), not elevation. Add Indigo glow on hover only — never at rest.

rules.name: The No-Decoration Rule
rules.body: Chips carry no icons, no indicators, no dots. The active/inactive border + color shift is the entire vocabulary.

rules.name: The Ambient Priority Rule
rules.body: Background theme changes and ambient mesh animations must never be blocked by UI state. Modals and panels use semi-transparent backgrounds — never opaque fills that kill the ambient layer underneath.

dos: Do use backdrop-filter: blur(24px) on every glass surface — widget cards, modals, header, sidebar.
Do treat Arctic Teal (#00d4aa) as the live/active signal. Any running process, playing media, or active timer gets a Teal treatment.
Do keep Outfit at weight 300 as the default. Reach for 400 only when a title must read as a heading.
Do animate widget card hover as translateY(-2px) — the slight lift is the interface's primary gesture language.
Do use Space Mono for all numeric readouts: clocks, countdown timers, pricing, keyboard hints.
Do respect prefers-reduced-motion. Expand this coverage with every new animated feature.
Do let the ambient layer show through every surface. New components must have semi-transparent backgrounds.
Do use uppercase labels (10px/500/0.12em tracking) as the only heading treatment at small scale.
donts: Don't add gamification mechanics — achievement toasts, streak counters, XP bars, level-up animations, or confetti.
Don't use Warm Amber (#f59e0b) for anything a free-tier user interacts with in a normal session.
Don't place Deep Indigo and Arctic Teal side-by-side at equal saturation.
Don't add structural box-shadows that simulate real-world elevation (large blur, significant offset, dark color).
Don't use solid opaque fills for any overlay, panel, or modal background. The ambient layer must always breathe through.
Don't use Space Mono for prose, navigation labels, or widget body copy.
Don't interrupt the ambient environment with celebratory, alarming, or high-motion UI patterns.
Don't design for the list: avoid feature-checklist UI that emphasizes quantity over experience.
